notice: DRAFT for human review. This file maps repository controls to SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria. It is NOT an attestation and Vireek holds no SOC 2 report. 'status' describes the control's design/implementation in the repo as reviewed on the basis date; it never means 'audited'. Owners are proposed roles only; a named person must be assigned by management.

statusLegend.met: Implemented in the repository AND at least one automated evidence collector exists for it. Public claims still require FRESH evidence.
statusLegend.partial: Partly implemented, or implemented but not provable from the repository (needs verification outside the repo, or a process is missing).
statusLegend.missing: No implementation or process exists yet.

controls.title: Information security policy set approved and communicated
controls.gap: All eleven policies are DRAFTS. None is approved, versioned by management, or acknowledged by staff.

controls.title: Workforce onboarding, offboarding, background checks and security-awareness training
controls.gap: No training records, no offboarding checklist for GitHub / Vercel / Supabase / provider consoles.

controls.title: Security documentation available to internal and external users
controls.gap: Documentation exists but has no review cadence or named maintainer.

controls.title: Security commitments and incidents communicated to customers
controls.gap: No breach-notification template or timeline.

controls.title: Public vulnerability-disclosure channel (security.txt + policy page)
controls.gap: security.txt carries an expiry date; evidence turns 'failing' when it is within 30 days of expiry or already expired.

controls.title: Annual risk assessment and risk register
controls.gap: No risk register exists.

controls.title: Ongoing evaluation of controls (this program)
controls.gap: Program is new: no scheduled run has produced evidence yet, and no owner reviews the dashboard on a cadence.

controls.title: Tenant data isolation enforced by Postgres row-level security
controls.gap: Evidence reports public tables without RLS and permissive USING(true) SELECT policies; any listed table needs a documented reason or a fix (see SOC2_READINESS.md F3).

controls.title: Authentication and multi-factor authentication
controls.gap: MFA is opt-in; it is not enforced for Vireek staff or tenant owners/admins. Evidence lists staff accounts without a verified MFA factor.

controls.title: Provisioning, deprovisioning and role-based access (SCIM / SSO / RBAC) with periodic access review
controls.gap: No quarterly access-review sign-off has been performed; provider consoles (GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, Twilio, Vapi) are outside the automated export.

controls.title: Privileged flag (profiles.is_staff) cannot be changed from the client
controls.gap: Other privileged columns (role, plan, billing state) are not covered by the same trigger (SOC2_READINESS.md F6).

controls.title: Boundary protection: security headers, IP allow-lists, session policy
controls.gap: IP allow-lists and session policies apply to enterprise accounts only; TLS termination is inherited from the hosting providers.

controls.title: Secret handling and secret scanning
controls.gap: No rotation cadence defined (RUNBOOK section 7 says 'decide'). GitHub secret-scanning alerts may be unavailable on the current plan; the collector reports that as 'blocked', never as 'pass'.

controls.title: Automated vulnerability and dependency scanning (npm audit, CodeQL, gitleaks, Dependabot)
controls.gap: Remediation SLAs exist only in the DRAFT vulnerability-management policy; evidence reports alerts older than those proposed thresholds.

controls.title: Peer review and branch protection for production changes
controls.gap: No CODEOWNERS file and no PR template in the repository. Branch protection and required reviews can only be proven from the GitHub API; evidence reports merged PRs without an independent approval.

controls.title: Automated CI gates: lint, type-check, unit tests, build, migration lint, edge-function check
controls.gap: Authenticated E2E specs are skipped in CI (no test credentials); migration clean-replay is non-blocking.

controls.title: Database migration discipline (additive policy, destructive-SQL lint)
controls.gap: Duplicate migration versions documented in RUNBOOK section 3.3.

controls.title: Environment separation and no shared or demo credentials in production
controls.gap: A demo user with a known password is created by a migration (SOC2_READINESS.md F5). Whether it exists in production, and whether a separate staging project exists, must be verified outside the repository.

controls.title: Application audit trail (audit_log) with tenant-scoped read access
controls.gap: No immutability protection against the service role; log retention period is not defined.

controls.title: Error and security-event monitoring
controls.gap: Sentry is active only when VITE_SENTRY_DSN is set in production (verify). No central log store or alert routing to a named on-call person.

controls.title: Incident response procedure with named roles and annual exercise
controls.gap: Procedure exists in RUNBOOK section 6; no named incident commander, no tabletop exercise record, no breach-notification timeline.

controls.title: Public status page and subscriber notifications for incidents
controls.gap: Incident post-mortems are not stored in a structured register.

controls.title: Availability monitoring: synthetic probes and SLO evaluation
controls.gap: Probe targets and the alert webhook must be configured in production (verify). Capacity planning is not documented.

controls.title: Scheduled logical backups to a private bucket with checksum
controls.gap: The scheduler, the private 'dr-backups' bucket and Supabase PITR/plan retention cannot be proven from the repository; the evidence shows only whether runs actually happened.

controls.title: Periodic restore drills with measured recovery time
controls.gap: RTO/RPO targets are not defined; no passed drill has been evidenced yet. platform_restore_drills / platform_backup_runs are readable by all authenticated tenants (SOC2_READINESS.md F3).

controls.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery plan with RTO/RPO
controls.gap: Policy is a draft; targets are proposals.

controls.title: Identification and classification of confidential data (PII registry, AI PII modes)
controls.gap: No approved data-classification policy; pii_field_registry must be kept current by hand.

controls.title: Data retention, legal hold and secure disposal (retention sweep, erasure workflow)
controls.gap: Retention periods for platform logs, backups and evidence are not defined in an approved policy.

controls.title: Vendor inventory, sub-processor list and annual vendor review
controls.gap: No vendor risk assessments or collected SOC 2 / ISO reports for Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Twilio, Vapi, or AI providers.

controls.title: Independent penetration test (annual, third party)
controls.gap: No third-party penetration test has been performed. The page that publishes pentest summaries exists; no summary exists.

controls.title: Physical and environmental security (inherited from hosting sub-service organizations)
controls.gap: Vireek operates no data centers. Reliance on Supabase / Vercel requires their current attestation reports, which have not been collected.
